target_text: // set_k_row takes bf16 rows only: convert other activation types first.
body:
**[comments] Rule 5, a call-site comment says only why here: shorten**

Lines 3104-3105 restate what the callee does (set_k_row's own comment and Note [K VNNI storage] item 1 both say the row is scattered into the token's column), and line 3106 restates k_source_row(kout) and that helper's no-copy comment. The one fact the call site adds is why the else branch stages a row, so keep that as one line directly above `alignas(64) bf16 row[...]` (line 3116) and drop the block at 3104-3108.

Proposed:
```cpp
// set_k_row takes bf16 rows only: convert other activation types first.
```
